name: Compli-Mints
ingredients: Sugar, Glucose Syrup (from corn), Water, Anticaking Agents (553, 570, Mineral Oil), Flavours, Colour (171), Glazing Agent (903, Vegetable Oil).
storage: STORE IN A COOL DRY PLACE.
note: Individually wrapped mints, 'COUNT APPROX 350' printed above the panel. Protein, fat total and saturated are printed '<1g' in both columns and are OMITTED rather than rounded; gluten is printed '0g'; sodium is printed '<5mg' in both columns and is likewise omitted. Allergen line reads 'ALLERGEN ADVICE: MAY BE PRESENT DAIRY AND SOY'. Front of pack also carries a 'GLUTEN FREE' flash. Ingredient list confirmed at native resolution against a glare-free second photo. Manufacturer name is printed only in tiny type on the individual sweet wrappers, not legibly.
